Author: Raebeauloves

Rating: ExplicitLanguage: EnglishWords: 2,364Chapters: 1/?Kudos: 2

Summary: This is six months after the season 9 Finale. (I wanted to keep Bobby alive, and I even did a version of it, but I feel like it would ruin Buck's growth)Buck meets a girl at a coffee shop, asks her out, and falls in love. Eddie feels a way about their relationship, and can't help but want in. Eddie falls in love with the girl and Buck. Everyone is happy. Buck, now a single father to Theo, meets Monique at a coffee shop. An instant connection is formed, but Buck is reluctant to move forward with Theo to think about it. Buck feels like its worth the risk, and ends up in love with Monique. However, a certain firefighter can't help but watch the relationship, feeling more drawn to it each day. It doesn't help that Monique constantly visits the station, is becoming his son's favorite person, and has many things in common with him. Doesn't help that Buck sometimes brings her along, but instead of feeling left out, he feels the situation is just something that has been missing. Worth the risk to try and find out more.

entry.title: ❝ come home ❞
entry.summary:
Author: 444diaz

Rating: MatureLanguage: EnglishWords: 34,634Chapters: 2/2Kudos: 17

Summary: When Theo is found badly injured, Buck is arrested for a crime he swears he didn’t commit. Separated from his son and unable to defend himself, he is left terrified that Theo will believe he abandoned—or betrayed—him. With Buck behind bars, Eddie steps in to protect Theo, while the 118 begins questioning the evidence that seems to condemn their friend. As fear, loyalty and family collide, they must uncover the truth before Buck loses everything. Because Theo needs somewhere safe to come home to. And Buck needs someone willing to bring him home.

entry.title: you're an angel (i'm a dog)
entry.summary:
Author: squishymar

Rating: MatureLanguage: EnglishWords: 16,278Chapters: 5/8Kudos: 23

Summary: He was something from the very beginning. Buck was loud. He was pouty. He was annoyingly stubborn. He was competitive in a way that made Eddie pause. Buck was nothing like anyone kept telling Eddie he was like. So when he risked his life in that ambulance. And Eddie told him he could have his back, he watched his face shift. His eyes softened in a way that felt familiar. Like he’s seen those eyes before. Like he's been waiting for someone to look at him like that. All Eddie could think was. Oh. I like you. _________ Or after breaking up, Buck and Eddie find not only themselves but each other in the process or (alternate season 9 where Buck and Eddie figure their shit out)
